build_REINFORCE_policy_learner: build a REINFORCE policy learner instance with a specified state dimension and actor hidden dims
create_REINFORCETransitionBatch_from_par: create a REINFORCETransitionBatch from an existing TransitionBatch using the from_parent classmethod
run_REINFORCE_learn: run the REINFORCE learn method on a REINFORCEReplayBuffer to compute cumulative rewards and update the policy
review_REINFORCE_actor_loss: review the REINFORCE _actor_loss method that computes the policy gradient loss with optional critic baseline
summarize_REINFORCE_critic_loss: summarize the REINFORCE _critic_loss method that computes the state value loss for the critic network
